```{r functions, include = FALSE}
parse_sequence_labels <- function(.data) {

  .data %>%
    mutate(

      # Identify sequence source
      seq_origin = if_else(
        str_detect(seqname, "UniRef90"),
        "UniRef90",
        "Seed"
      ),

      # Sequence ID
      sequence_id = seqname,

      # Gene name
      gene_name = case_when(

        # sequenceid_gene_name_[organism]
        seq_origin == "Seed" ~
          str_match(
            tax_id,
            "^[^_]+_(.*)_\\["
          )[, 2],

        seq_origin == "UniRef90" ~
          str_match(
            tax_id,
            "^\\s*(.*?)_n="
          )[, 2],

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      # Number of sequences represented by UniRef cluster
      n_sequences = case_when(

        seq_origin == "UniRef90" ~
          as.integer(
            str_match(
              tax_id,
              "_n=([0-9]+)_Tax="
            )[, 2]
          ),

        TRUE ~ NA_integer_
      ),

      # Organism
      organism = case_when(

        # [...organism...]
        seq_origin == "Seed" ~
          str_match(
            tax_id,
            "\\[(.*)\\]$"
          )[, 2],

        # _Tax=organism_TaxID=
        seq_origin == "UniRef90" ~
          str_match(
            tax_id,
            "_Tax=(.*?)_TaxID="
          )[, 2],

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      # Make organism names readable
      organism = str_replace_all(
        organism,
        "_",
        " "
      ),
      genus = word(organism, 1), 

      # NCBI TaxID for UniRef sequences
      NCBI_taxid = case_when(

        seq_origin == "UniRef90" ~
          str_match(
            tax_id,
            "_TaxID=([0-9]+)"
          )[, 2],

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      # Everything following TaxID
      other_information = case_when(

        seq_origin == "UniRef90" ~
          str_match(
            tax_id,
            "_TaxID=[0-9]+_(.*)$"
          )[, 2],

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}


```

```{r wrangling}
trees <- tibble(gene = c(
  #"all_dh",
  "EC_1_1_1_1", 
  "EC_1_1_1_6", 
  "EC_1_1_1_18", 
  "EC_1_1_1_215", 
  "EC_1_1_5_2")) %>%
  mutate(
    tree_path = map_chr(gene, ~ list.files(here(main_dir, .), pattern = "graftm_create_tree.combined.tree", full.names = T)),
    tree = purrr::map(tree_path, ~read.tree(file = .)),
    tax_path = map_chr(gene, ~ list.files(here(main_dir, .), pattern = "graftm_create_seqinfo", full.names = T)),
    taxonomy = map(tax_path, ~read_csv(file = .)),
    alignment_path = map_chr(gene, ~ list.files(here(main_dir, .), pattern = "graftm_create_alignment", full.names = T)),
    metadata = map(taxonomy, ~ parse_sequence_labels(.))
  )


trees$taxonomy[[1]] %>% parse_sequence_labels() %>% View()

```

```{r spec-summary-function}
plot_tree <- function(trees) {
  tree <- trees %>% pull("tree") %>% pluck(1) 
  metadata <- trees %>% pull("metadata") %>% pluck(1) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "sequence_id")
  gene_id <- trees %>% pull("gene") %>% pluck(1)
  fasta_file <- trees %>% pull("alignment_path") %>% pluck(1)
  
  filename <- paste0(gene_id,"_","draft_tree.pdf")
  p <- ggtree(tree,) %<+%
    metadata +
    #  geom_tiplab(
    #   aes(label = gene_name),
    #   align = T
    # ) +
     #geom_text2(aes(label = organism)) +
     geom_tippoint(
       aes(
         subset = seq_origin == "Seed",
         color = genus)) +
    ggtitle(gene_id)
  p <- msaplot(
  p,
  fasta = fasta_file,
  offset = 0.05,
  width = 2
 )
  ggsave(p, filename = here(main_dir, gene_id, filename), width = 20, height = 20)
  return(p)
}





plot_tree(trees[1,])

# Run trees
trees <- trees %>%
  mutate(
    plot = map(
      seq_len(nrow(trees)),
      \(i) plot_tree(trees[i, ])
    )
)

```

```{r}

filter_trees_to_seed_genera <- function(trees) {

  filtered <- map2(
    trees$tree,
    trees$metadata,
    \(tree, metadata) {

      seed_genera <- metadata %>%
        filter(seq_origin == "Seed") %>%
        pull(genus) %>%
        na.omit() %>%
        unique()

      metadata_filtered <- metadata %>%
        filter(genus %in% seed_genera)

      tips_to_keep <- intersect(
        tree$tip.label,
        metadata_filtered$seqname
      )

      tree_filtered <- keep.tip(
        tree,
        tips_to_keep
      )

      metadata_filtered <- metadata_filtered %>%
        filter(seqname %in% tree_filtered$tip.label) %>%
        slice(match(tree_filtered$tip.label, seqname))

      list(
        tree = tree_filtered,
        metadata = metadata_filtered
      )
    }
  )

  trees %>%
    mutate(
      tree = map(filtered, "tree"),
      metadata = map(filtered, "metadata")
    )
}

trees_seed_genera <- filter_trees_to_seed_genera(trees)

plot_tree <- function(trees) {
  tree <- trees %>% pull("tree") %>% pluck(1) 
  metadata <- trees %>% pull("metadata") %>% pluck(1) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "sequence_id")
  gene_id <- trees %>% pull("gene") %>% pluck(1)
  fasta_file <- trees %>% pull("alignment_path") %>% pluck(1)
  
  filename <- paste0(gene_id,"_","filtered_draft_tree.pdf")
  p <- ggtree(tree,) %<+%
    metadata +
     geom_tiplab(
      aes(label = gene_name),
      align = T
    ) +
     #geom_text2(aes(label = organism)) +
     geom_tippoint(
       alpha = 0.5,
       aes(
         #subset = seq_origin == "Seed",
         color = genus,
         shape = seq_origin)) +
    ggtitle(gene_id)
  ggsave(p, filename = here(main_dir, gene_id, filename), width = 20, height = 20)
  return(p)
}
# Run trees
trees_seed_genera <- trees_seed_genera %>%
  mutate(
    plot = map(
      seq_len(nrow(trees)),
      \(i) plot_tree(trees[i, ])
    )
)


plot_tree(trees_seed_genera[1,])
```
